title: ALLO Ultra 500 2ml Disposable – Cool Mint
description:
2ml, pre-filled disposable

Cool Mint

Each Allo Disposable vape bar comes with 2mL of e-liquid and 500mAh battery size to maximize flavourful puffs. For full line up of flavours visit our Allo page.

PLEASE NOTE that when ordering any item from ThunderbirdVapes.com you will be required to show valid government ID to receive your shipment. The name on the ID, order and payment must be the same and the recipient must be 19 years of age or older.
